# Ghostfolio IBKR Sync

> Import Interactive Brokers Flex activities and base-currency cash into self-hosted Ghostfolio with Docker Compose.

## Scope and prerequisites

- Use this entry for user setup, not contributor work. Keep guides, Compose and ENV examples at the same revision.
- Import trades, dividends and withholding tax. Cash updates run separately from activity imports.
- Exclude options and FX trades. Handle corporate actions and older history manually; Flex covers at most 365 days.
- Require Git, Docker Compose and reachable Ghostfolio 2.248.0+. Use one Flex query and one target per IBKR account.
- Obtain an IBKR Flex Web Service token and query ID. Follow the [Flex field checklist](https://github.com/flowcool/ghostfolio-ibkr-sync/blob/main/docs/ibkr-setup.md#2-create-a-flex-query): XML, 365 days, required time format, Corporate Actions even when empty.
- Obtain a Ghostfolio Security Token and create a target account with the IBKR base currency. Store credentials only in private ENV files.

## Safety requirements

- MUST simulate first. Simulation logs in, reads services and maintains local state; it sends no financial writes.
- MUST keep live writes disabled until the human reviews the simulation and explicitly approves the import.
- MUST back up Ghostfolio with a verified procedure before the first import. Retain image digest, ENV, mapping, state and evidence.
- MUST never print tokens, commit secrets or show resolved Compose configuration. Use the quiet validation command below.
- MUST never delete state to clear a hold. Preserve journals and follow the named recovery procedure.
- MUST stop and ask the human after an uncertain write. Never resend it automatically. Image rollback does not undo financial writes.
- MUST avoid concurrent processes for the same account. Review proximity matches manually; proximity does not prove identity.

## Install, simulate, review, import, schedule

Use the commands from [First installation](https://github.com/flowcool/ghostfolio-ibkr-sync/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md) in order.
Start with the supplied single-account Compose model:

```bash
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/flowcool/ghostfolio-ibkr-sync.git
cd ghostfolio-ibkr-sync
cp .env.example .env
cp mapping.yaml.example mapping.yaml
chmod 600 .env mapping.yaml
```

Edit `.env` with the settings below. Edit `mapping.yaml` before changing ownership; keep its `symbol_mapping` structure.
Verify unmapped ISIN destinations before import. Keep simulation enabled.
Select the existing Docker network that contains Ghostfolio. Replace `<ghostfolio-container>` with its name:

```bash
docker inspect <ghostfolio-container> --format '{{json .NetworkSettings.Networks}}'
```

Set the network and a reachable service name or alias with its port. Use HTTPS outside the trusted Docker network.
Compose does not attach Ghostfolio or create this network. Prepare private persistent state:

```bash
mkdir -p state/individual
chmod 700 state/individual
sudo chown 10001:10001 mapping.yaml state/individual
docker compose config --quiet
```

The image runs as `10001:10001`. Mapping stays read-only, mode `0600`; state stays writable, mode `0700`, at `/state`.
For an existing installation, stop the scheduled service before a manual run:

```bash
docker compose stop ibkr-sync-individual
```

Run the simulation. Retain private logs and review account, securities, currency, quantities, fees, cash, skips and holds:

```bash
docker compose run --rm -e DRY_RUN=true -e CRON= ibkr-sync-individual
```

Resolve unsafe holds. Simulation does not prove server acceptance. After human review, explicit approval and backup, run once with scheduling still stopped:

```bash
docker compose run --rm -e DRY_RUN=false -e CRON= ibkr-sync-individual
```

Check the result before scheduling. Add missing currency pairs and run Gather All Data as [documented](https://github.com/flowcool/ghostfolio-ibkr-sync/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#after-your-first-import).
Only after approval for recurring imports, set `DRY_RUN=false` and `CRON_INDIVIDUAL` in `.env`, then start:

```bash
docker compose up -d
```

For multiple accounts or existing two-service installations, use the [separate model and migration](https://github.com/flowcool/ghostfolio-ibkr-sync/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md#multiple-accounts). Never share state directories.

## ENV settings

Use the supplied `.env.example` for Compose; replace its placeholders. Consult [configuration](https://github.com/flowcool/ghostfolio-ibkr-sync/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#configuration-reference) for other modes.

- `IBKR_TOKEN`: required Flex Web Service token; no usable default.
- `IBKR_ACCOUNT_IDS_INDIVIDUAL`: required source account ID; replace the example.
- `IBKR_QUERY_IDS_INDIVIDUAL`: required single-account Flex query ID; replace the example.
- `GHOST_ACCOUNT_NAME_INDIVIDUAL`: required exact Ghostfolio target name; replace the example.
- `GHOST_ACCESS_TOKEN`: recommended Ghostfolio Security Token; exchanged each run; no usable default.
- `GHOST_TOKEN`: legacy expiring session bearer alternative; leave unset for the recommended mode.
- `GHOST_DOCKER_NETWORK`: existing Ghostfolio network; replace `ghostfolio` if needed.
- `GHOST_HOST`: default `http://ghostfolio:3333`; requires that alias on the selected network.
- `TZ`: required valid IANA timezone for writes; example `Europe/Paris`; match the Ghostfolio server timezone. Missing or invalid forces simulation.
- `DRY_RUN`: keep `true` through review; current images default to simulation. Explicitly set it on older images too.
- `CRON_INDIVIDUAL`: five numeric fields; example `0 6 * * *`; keep the service stopped until scheduling is approved.
- `CRON`: runtime schedule; an empty value runs once immediately; the manual commands override it.
- `LOG_LEVEL`: keep `INFO`; protect logs.
- `APPRISE_URLS`: optional notifications; default `[]` disables them.

## Read results and recover

- Read the final `Cycle result`: `success`, `success with user action required`, or `failure`. Failure takes priority.
- Check accepted imports or simulated proposals, duplicates, review-held events, other holds and deferred work separately. Unknown evidence reads `unavailable`.
- For blocked work, follow each required action and its evidence file. State errors or holds can cause exit 1 even in simulation; do not force a write.
- Cash reports `simulated`, `request reported successful`, `not updated` or `uncertain/failed`. Request success is not independent balance readback or proof that activities imported.
- A successful buy can remain after a later sell fails. Preserve evidence and use [troubleshooting](https://github.com/flowcool/ghostfolio-ibkr-sync/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md) before retrying.
- Notification `sent` confirms transport, not device receipt. Clean success sends no heartbeat.
